messages:
Ana C: Heads-up — QBR prep: marketplace credit runway + SI onboarding pilots. Need to reconcile MDF slab commitments vs. marketplace promo credits before Friday.
Samir: Can you drop the current numbers? I only have the patchy spreadsheet from last month.
Ana C: Putting the latest here: https://redwood-internal.docs/qbr/si-marketplace-credit (view-only). Key ask: confirm which SI partners are eligible for co-funded credits (list in sheet) and whether we can reassign unused credits to marketplace launch pilots.
Marcus L: Quick note — hardware partner (NimbelEdge) explicitly forbids reassigning dedicated HW credits to marketplace SKUs. Need to keep those separate. :warning:
Priya N: Understood re: NimbelEdge. For MDF we can split 60/40 marketplace vs SI onboarding for Q3, but need partner opt-in.
Jules (sales ops): Who owns partner opt-ins? I can run a sweep email but need the exact opt-in copy. Also need scorecard metric to link to (pipeline influenced vs validated SI integrations).
Ana C: Assigned: @Jules (sales ops) — sweep email. @Samir @Marcus L — confirm opt-in list and HW constraints. I'll draft opt-in copy.
Samir: Confirmed list in the sheet (tab: "opt-ins"). Also added a column `hw_restriction` for partners with hardware constraints.
Marcus L: Added a short note to the sheet explaining NimbelEdge constraint and the contact at their PM.
Ana C: Draft opt-in copy in thread (please comment):
```
Hi <PartnerName>,
We’re finalizing Q3 enablement credits. You’re currently eligible for a co-funded marketplace pilot (credits) and an SI onboarding stipend. Please confirm within 7 days if you opt in to the marketplace pilot. Note: hardware credits cannot be re-assigned to marketplace use.
Reply with "Opt-in: Marketplace" or "No thanks" and we'll allocate credits accordingly.
```
Priya N: wording looks good. Add an FAQ bullet: "Can credits be moved later?" -> Short answer: No for HW credits, yes for unused MDF within the same program with approval.
Jules (sales ops): I'll send the sweep at 11:00 PT. Can someone add the final numbers in the sheet by 10:30? I need the `final_mdf_alloc` column populated.
Samir: Will update `final_mdf_alloc` by 10:15. Also flag: Marketplace-bot will auto-provision promo credits only if `promo_flag=TRUE` in the sheet.
marketplace-bot: Automated check: promo_flag column present. 18 rows flagged TRUE. Next run at 11:05.
Ana C: Next steps recap:
- Samir: finalize `final_mdf_alloc` by 10:15 (sheet: opt-ins tab).
- Marcus: confirm HW constraints + contact notes.
- Jules: send opt-in sweep at 11:00 PT.
- Priya: prepare scorecard metrics for QBR (pipeline influence, integrations validated).
I'll consolidate responses and propose the final allocation by EOD.
Samir: One more ask — can finance confirm whether we can carry over small unused tokens (<$5k) into marketplace promos? I think policy is no but need a confirmation.
Ana C: @Priya N can loop in finance after she completes scorecard. I'll draft the EOD allocation note once we have opt-ins.
Priya N: Will loop in @FinanceOps after I assemble the scorecard. ETA 16:00 PT.
Marcus L: LGTM. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Jules (sales ops): Thanks — sending in 10.
